title: Clarify checks before forcing closed-task cleanup
outcome: Make the cleanup instructions explicit about protecting unique uncommitted content and handling targets whose served items cannot be identified.
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md explain how to distinguish the narrow allowed native completion from a refusal caused by unique uncommitted tracked or untracked work, and preserve that work.
The matching instructions explain how to establish which items a target served and what to do when those items cannot be identified.
